items.t: 래블업, 로컬 AI 앱 'AI:GO 2.0' 출시…PC서 에이전트 실행
items.d: 래블업은 외부 클라우드 없이 개인용 컴퓨터에서 인공지능(AI) 모델과 에이전트를 실행할 수 있는 앱 '에이아이고(AI:GO)' 2.0 버전을 출시했다고 27일 밝혔다. 에이아이고는 언어·비전·음성 AI 모델을 실행하는 로컬 AI 앱이다. 외부 서버로 데이터를 전송하지 않고 PC에서 AI 모델을 실행해 클라우드 이용 비용과 데이터 유출 부담을 낮췄다. 대화창에서 텍스트 기반 대화, 이미지 생성, 음성 받아쓰기, 실시간 문서 번역 등을 지원한다.
items.fullText: AI·SW SW 래블업, 로컬 AI 앱 'AI:GO 2.0' 출시…PC서 에이전트 실행 발행일 : 2026-11-27 17:11 전자신문을 선호 매체로 추가 공유하기 페이스북 X(트위터) X(트위터) --> 메일 URL 복사 글자크기 설정 가 작게 가 보통 가 크게 로컬 AI 모델·에이전트 앱 '에이아이고(AI:GO)'. 래블업 래블업은 외부 클라우드 없이 개인용 컴퓨터에서 인공지능(AI) 모델과 에이전트를 실행할 수 있는 앱 '에이아이고(AI:GO)' 2.0 버전을 출시했다고 27일 밝혔다. 에이아이고는 언어·비전·음성 AI 모델을 실행하는 로컬 AI 앱이다. 외부 서버로 데이터를 전송하지 않고 PC에서 AI 모델을 실행해 클라우드 이용 비용과 데이터 유출 부담을 낮췄다. 대화창에서 텍스트 기반 대화, 이미지 생성, 음성 받아쓰기, 실시간 문서 번역 등을 지원한다. 벤치마크 기반으로 AI 모델별 PC 구동 속도를 측정해 PC 환경에 적합한 모델을 선택할 수 있다. 채팅, 장문의 문서 처리 등 작업 용도에 최적화된 AI 모델 자동 설정 기능도 탑재했다. 핵심 기능은 실행형 AI 에이전트 '코워크'다. 사용자가 채팅창에 작업 폴더를 첨부하면 AI가 파일을 직접 읽고 대량 파일 정리, 코드 구조 개선, 자료 분석 등을 수행한다. 여러 에이전트가 역할을 나눠 복잡한 업무를 처리하는 '스쿼드' 기능도 제공한다. 보안 기능도 강화했다. 마이크로소프트(MS)의 실행 격리 기술에 기반해 운용체계(OS) 샌드박스를 통합했다. AI 에이전트가 접근하는 파일의 접근 범위를 제한하고 네트워크 연결도 기본 차단한다. 결제·주문·전송·삭제 등 민감 작업은 사용자 승인을 거친다. 기업과 연구기관에는 폐쇄망 운영을 지원하는 상용 버전을 제공한다. 그래픽처리장치(GPU) 운영 플랫폼 '백엔드닷에이아이'와 연동해 프런티어 AI 모델도 활용할 수 있다. 신정규 래블업 대표는 “AI가 실제 업무 파일과 도구를 다루는 에이전트로 쓰이면서 OS 수준의 실행 안전성, 예측 가능한 비용 구조가 중요해졌다”며 “개인 노트북부터 팀 워크스테이션, 기업 GPU 클러스터까지 일관된 로컬 AI 환경을 제공하겠다”고 말했다. 조벼리 기자 starry@etnews.com

SAP Weighs Cutting at Least 10,000 Roles in AI Restructure
items.d: SAP SE is preparing a plan to eliminate at least 10,000 positions to transform its software business for the artificial intelligence era, according to people familiar with the matter, following reductions at Oracle Corp. and Microsoft Corp.

Send a tip to our reporters Site feedback: Take our Survey New Window Facebook X LinkedIn Email Link Gift By Christina Kyriasoglou November 26, 2026 at 4:15 PM UTC Updated on November 27, 2026 at 8:09 AM UTC Bookmark Save SAP SE is preparing a plan to eliminate at least 10,000 positions to transform its software business for the artificial intelligence era, according to people familiar with the matter, following reductions at Oracle Corp. and Microsoft Corp. SAP’s restructuring would affect at least 9% of the global workforce, the people said, asking not to be identified because discussions are ongoing. The total number of job cuts hasn’t been finalized and might still change after labor negotiations, they added.

items.fullText: NVIDIA and Microsoft Expand Accelerated Computing From Azure to Windows PCs NVIDIA and Microsoft expand tools for enterprises to customize AI models and deploy applications across cloud and local infrastructure. November 19, 2026 by Dave Salvator 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA and Microsoft are extending their full-stack collaboration to help organizations build, customize and deploy intelligent applications — from next-generation infrastructure on Azure to industrial systems and Windows PCs. At Microsoft Ignite , the companies are expanding access to Azure virtual machines powered by NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems, as well as adding customer availability to NVIDIA open models and customization capabilities through Microsoft Foundry, and new options for running AI at the edge, where businesses generate and use their data. Microsoft is also using NVIDIA technologies to accelerate its own models and services, including NVIDIA Dynamo inference software for post-training and NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs for Bing search models. NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Running in Azure NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems are running in Azure data centers , providing infrastructure designed for demanding reasoning, agentic applications, and large-scale model training and inference. Microsoft and NVIDIA are also collaborating to extend confidential computing to bare-metal and rack-scale AI infrastructure. The work will help protect sensitive models and data while they are being processed, supporting organizations that need to work with proprietary or regulated information. NVIDIA Confidential Computing and attestation help customers verify the computing environment before releasing sensitive models, data or keys. As AI workloads span more interconnected accelerators, the companies are working to extend those protections across the AI factory infrastructure. items.fullText: Lambda Boosts AI Factory Resiliency and Efficiency With NVIDIA Photonics November 16, 2026 by Brian Sparks 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! To train an AI model, thousands of GPUs have to work together, requiring a network that’s fast, efficient and resilient. Lambda is tackling the network piece of the puzzle with NVIDIA Photonics co-packaged optics (CPO) switches. The cloud provider is using the switches to connect NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 racks with more than 10,000 GPUs, delivering lower power, higher resiliency and longer mean time between interruptions (MTBI) to an AI factory at scale. “Networking has to keep pace with the demands of increasingly large AI clusters,” said Dave Ward, president of cloud services at Lambda. “Bringing co-packaged optics into a deployment of this scale is an important step toward building the infrastructure needed to support the next generation of AI.” Read All NVIDIA Announcements From SC26 In the company’s tests using the switches, network latency — the time needed for moving data — dropped by about 4% at rack scale and by up to about 10% at pod scale. Across rack, scalable unit and pod configurations, the network maintains the same throughput as conventional pluggable optics. Delivering Power Efficiency and Resiliency at Scale Improving power efficiency and resiliency matters because the network sits at the center of AI factory productivity. In a large training job, one interrupted link can stall thousands of GPUs. With agentic inference, one network disruption can introduce cascading latency effects on many agents. Every interruption costs time, and every watt spent on networking is a watt not available for compute. NVIDIA Photonics addresses both power efficiency and resiliency. By replacing pluggable transceivers with co-packaged optical engines on the switch package, it delivers up to 5x better power efficiency and up to 15x higher reliability than conventional pluggable optics. November 12, 2026 by GeForce NOW Community 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Rally the ranks this GFN Thursday. Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV is coming to GeForce NOW , allowing players to experience the battle for Kronus through cloud gaming. There’s more on the horizon, with NVIDIA DLSS 5 technology coming to War Thunder and Where Winds Meet . Meanwhile, Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen brings new tales and encounters, alongside 10 games joining the GeForce NOW library this week. Kronus Calls for Reinforcements Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV , developed by KING Art Games and published by Deep Silver, is coming to GeForce NOW. Launching on Steam Thursday, Dec. 3, the real-time strategy game returns to the series’ roots with large-scale battles, base building and a renewed fight for planet Kronus. Command the Space Marines, Orks, Necrons or the Adeptus Mechanicus, which makes their series debut. Build a base, secure resources and customize squads to the conflict across more than 70 campaign missions, playable solo or in co-op mode. The Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes offer more ways to put tactics to the test. GeForce NOW will bring the action to supported PCs, Macs, handhelds and other devices, with game downloads and updates handled in the cloud. Save the storage space for everyday essentials and planning for the next offensive. Wishlist the game on Steam , and stay tuned to GFN Thursday to prepare for launch. DLSS 5 Keeps on Coming NVIDIA DLSS 5 continues to evolve, with Gaijin Entertainment’s War Thunder and Everstone Studio’s Where Winds Meet next to receive support for the technology with the 3D-Guided Neural Rendering feature.
